mapper.sql: select so.stock_out_id, so.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, so.batch_no, so.operator, so.out_time, so.customer, so.type, CASE so.type WHEN '0' THEN '销售出库' ELSE '' END as type_desc, so.status, CASE so.status WHEN '0' THEN '未出库' WHEN '1' THEN '已出库' WHEN '2' THEN '作废' ELSE '' END as status_desc, so.total_quantity, so.remark, so.create_people, so.create_time, so.update_people, so.update_time from inv_stock_out so left join inv_warehouse w on so.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select concat('SO-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '-', lpad(ifnull(max(substring(stock_out_id, 13)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) as stock_out_id from inv_stock_out where stock_out_id like concat('SO-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '%') and del_flag = '0'
